shared_elements: horizontal register or band separating parts of the composition
justification: The most specific overlap is that both include stylized living figures rendered largely in profile, with at least one anthropomorphic/human-like figure and some linear objects or signs. The major difference is that A is a scene of two large standing human figures facing one another and holding vessels/weapons, while B is a register-like assemblage dominated by animals and abstract signs with no comparable paired human interaction.
